## F — Fitness to drive

Research index: Fitness to drive is grounded in mapped physical pages 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25. Part C contains the main knowledge facts and part C2 continues the facts and confusables.
Consolidated VERIFY list: sec03-EFFECTIVE (effective date), sec03-BANK (total bank size), sec03-CLEARANCE-TIMING, sec03-CRASH-STAT, and market/teardown debt in E and E2.
Question count, passing percentage and untimed-test status are copied only from the verified run scope. All source anchors resolve to the registered PDF snapshot. No official domain weighting is supplied.
Dynamic facts: Legal sanctions and test-refusal rules are revision-bound and require issuer refresh; undated crash statistics and fixed sober-up calculations are isolated as debt.

corpus_stability.reason: The bound Kansas handbook has one February 2022 revision label; the selected source contains no evidence of multiple annual corpus rewrites. Later legal or administrative changes require issuer rechecking.

market_signal.origin_note: Market evidence is handled in part E.
